data.value: You cannot access your existing server logs after this system upgrade.

data.name: DetailTextNoBackwardCompability
data.value:
1. Cancel this installation. 2. Open {0} and export your existing server logs to a text file that you can access when needed. 3. Restart this installation.
For more information, see: {{0}}

data.name: DetailTextMoreSecureLog
data.value:
1. Continue this installation. 2. Open {0} immediately after installation. 3. On the "Tools" tab, select "Options", and then on the "Server Logs" tab, select the "Allow 2018 R2 and earlier components to write logs" check box. This allows system components regardless of version to write their logs to the log server database. 4. Check the version of all system components that write logs and upgrade them if they are version 2018 R2 (12.2a) or earlier. 5. Open {1} again and clear the "Allow 2018 R2 and earlier components to write logs" check box.
For more information, see: {{0}}

data.name: BodyTextMoreSecureLog
data.value: You may have system components that are version 2018 R2 (12.2a) or earlier and that write logs. These system components write their logs in a less secure way than later versions.
